configuration.note: Only commission_value was changed between scenarios (a cost assumption). No strategy logic or parameters changed. Editor restored to commission 0.05 after the runs (re-verified to the digit).

measured_scenarios.note: Binance taker only; identical to the verified reproduction baseline.
0.05 Binance taker + 0.02 modeled slippage per side (percent-based). RECOMMENDED public headline.
0.05 taker + 0.05 stress slippage per side. Conservative cost floor.

slippage_modeling_method: TradingView supports percent commission (strategy.commission.percent). Slippage is modeled as ADDITIONAL percent commission (per side), NOT as TradingView's fixed-tick slippage field. Rationale: a fixed tick cannot hold a constant percentage across BTC's ~$4k-$110k range over 2020-2026, so a percent model is the defensible choice. Commission is charged on notional per side, the same basis as a percent slippage assumption.

cost_sensitivity.definition: net-% points lost per 0.01% of round-trip cost added (compounding-inclusive)
cost_sensitivity.nonlinear_note: More sensitive at lower cost (larger compounding base). 510 trades => high turnover => more cost-sensitive than the prior long-only probe (-14.0).
cost_sensitivity.slippage_alone_impact: A->B (+0.02%/side) removes 105.51 net-pts = 16.9% of the commission-only net.

funding_estimate.reason: TradingView has no perpetual-funding model. Funding is computed analytically and converted to net-% impact via the MEASURED cost-sensitivity (-24 pts / 0.01% round-trip), so compounding is handled like commission.
funding_estimate.side_treatment: Conservative: funding treated as a COST on held notional regardless of side. A both-sides trend strategy tends to sit on the paying side (longs pay in positive-funding uptrends; shorts pay in negative-funding downtrends).

hold_time_assumptions.notional_weighted_basis: runner leg carries ~95% of notional and is held 1-3 days; funding $ is dominated by the long-held runners. CONSERVATIVE and the more realistic anchor.

cost_bite_summary.verdict: Realistic costs take a ~40% central bite (range ~22-52%) out of the in-sample commission-only +623.91%. Edge survives: even the conservative all-in stays PF>1.7 and CAGR>24%/yr. Headline live expectation must be set ~40% below the +624% paper figure.
